## Simulation study

### setting 1

a mixture whose two components are clearly separated. 

```{r}
#generate a dataset

set.seed(1)

n <- 100
allocation <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.7)
separate_data <- allocation*rnorm(n, -2, 1) + (1 - allocation)*rnorm(n, 2, 1)

hist(separate_data, breaks = 20)

```

Initialisation 1: $\mu_1 < \mu_2$.
Initialisation 2:$\mu_1 > \mu_2$.

```{r}
source("sampler.R")
set.seed(1)

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 2,
  beta_0 = 1
)

initialisation1 <- list(
      mu_1    = -1,
      mu_2    = 1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )

initialisation2 <- list(
      mu_1    = 1,
      mu_2    = -1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )

separate_gibbs1 = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation1)
separate_gibbs2 = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation2)

mu_1_vector1 <- sapply(separate_gibbs1, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector1 <- sapply(separate_gibbs1, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector1 <- sapply(separate_gibbs1, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector1 <- sapply(separate_gibbs1, function (x) x$sigma2)

mu_1_vector2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs2, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs2, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs2, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs2, function (x) x$sigma2)

```



```{r}

pdf(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting1_trace.pdf")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

plot(mu_1_vector1, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[1]), ylim = c(-3,3), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1])), col="blue")

lines(mu_1_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")

plot(mu_2_vector1, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[2]), ylim = c(-3,3),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[2])) , col="blue")

lines(mu_2_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")

legend("right",
       legend = c(
         expression( paste("Initial ", mu[1], "<",  mu[2])), 
         expression( paste("Initial ", mu[1], ">",  mu[2]))),
       col = c("blue", "orange"),
       lty = 1,
       cex = 0.8)

plot(pi_vector1, type = "l", ylab = expression(pi), ylim = c(0,1),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi)), col="blue")

lines(pi_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")

plot(sigma2_vector1, type = "l", ylab = expression(sigma^2),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", sigma^2)), col="blue")

lines(sigma2_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")


dev.off()

```


```{r}

pdf(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting1_init1_acf.pdf")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

acf(mu_1_vector1, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[1])))
acf(mu_2_vector1, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[2])))
acf(pi_vector1, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", pi)))
acf(sigma2_vector1, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", sigma^2)))

dev.off()

```


```{r}

pdf(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting1_init2_acf.pdf")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

acf(mu_1_vector2, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[1])))
acf(mu_2_vector2, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[2])))
acf(pi_vector2, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", pi)))
acf(sigma2_vector2, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", sigma^2)))

dev.off()

```
Init 3 : Both mu way high test

```{r}
source("sampler.R")
set.seed(1)

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 2,
  beta_0 = 1
)

initialisation3 <- list(
      mu_1    = 3,
      mu_2    = 2,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )


separate_gibbs3 = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, burn = 0, hyperparams, initialisation3)


mu_1_vector3 <- sapply(separate_gibbs3, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector3 <- sapply(separate_gibbs3, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector3 <- sapply(separate_gibbs3, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector3 <- sapply(separate_gibbs3, function (x) x$sigma2)

```


```{r}
#pdf(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting1_init3_trace.pdf")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

plot(mu_1_vector3, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[1]), ylim = c(-3,3), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1])))


plot(mu_2_vector3, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[2]), ylim = c(-3,3),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[2])) )


plot(pi_vector3, type = "l", ylab = expression(pi), ylim = c(0,1),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi)))


plot(sigma2_vector3, type = "l", ylab = expression(sigma^2),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", sigma^2)))

#dev.off()

```


### setting 2

A mixture whose not clearly separated

```{r}

#generate a dataset

set.seed(1)

n <- 100
allocation <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.7)
mixed_data <- allocation*rnorm(n, -1, 1) + (1 - allocation)*rnorm(n, 1, 1)

hist(mixed_data, breaks = 20)

```


#### With or without restriction

```{r}

source("sampler.R")
set.seed(1)

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 2,
  beta_0 = 1
)

initialisation <- list(
      mu_1    = -1,
      mu_2    = 1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )

mixed_gibbs_1 = gibbs_sampler(mixed_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation)
mixed_gibbs_2 = gibbs_sampler(mixed_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation, allow_switching=FALSE)

mu_1_vector <- sapply(mixed_gibbs_1, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector <- sapply(mixed_gibbs_1, function (x) x$mu_2)
mu_1_vector_2 <- sapply(mixed_gibbs_2, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector_2 <- sapply(mixed_gibbs_2, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector <- sapply(mixed_gibbs_1, function (x) x$pi)
pi_vector_2 <- sapply(mixed_gibbs_2, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector <- sapply(mixed_gibbs_1, function (x) x$sigma2)
sigma2_vector_2 <- sapply(mixed_gibbs_2, function (x) x$sigma2)

```

```{r}
mean(pi_vector)
mean(mu_1_vector)
mean(mu_2_vector)
mean(sigma2_vector)
```

```{r}
mean(pi_vector_2)
mean(mu_1_vector_2)
mean(mu_2_vector_2)
```


```{r}

pdf(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting2_trace.pdf")

par(mfrow=c(3,2))

plot(mu_1_vector, 
     type = "l",
     ylab = expression(mu), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1], " and ", mu[2], " without restriction")), 
     col="blue", 
     ylim=c(-3, 3))

lines(mu_2_vector, type = "l", col="orange")

plot(mu_1_vector_2, 
     type = "l", 
     ylab = expression(mu), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1], " and ", mu[2], " with restriction")),
     col="blue", ylim=c(-3, 3))

lines(mu_2_vector_2, type = "l",col="orange")

legend("topright",
       legend = c(expression(mu[1]), expression(mu[2])),
       col = c("blue", "orange"),
       lty = 1,
       cex = 0.8)

plot(pi_vector,
     type="l", 
     ylab = expression(pi), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi, " without restriction")), 
     ylim=c(0, 1) )

plot(pi_vector_2, type="l", 
     ylab = expression(pi), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi, " with restriction")), 
     ylim=c(0, 1) )

plot(sigma2_vector,
     type="l", 
     ylab = expression(sigma^2), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", sigma^2, " without restriction")))

plot(sigma2_vector_2,
     type="l", 
     ylab = expression(sigma^2), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", sigma^2, " with restriction")))

dev.off()

```


```{r}

plot_two_acfs <- function(x, y, main) {
  acf_x <- acf(x, plot = FALSE)
  acf_y <- acf(y, plot = FALSE)

  plot(acf_x$lag, acf_x$acf,
       type = "h",
       col = "blue",
       lwd = 2,
       ylim = c(0, 1.2),
       xlab = "Lag",
       ylab = "ACF",
       main = main)

  lines(acf_y$lag, acf_y$acf,
        type = "h",
        col = "orange",
        lwd = 2)

  legend("topright",
         legend = c("Without restriction", "With restriction"),
         col = c("blue", "orange"),
         lwd = 2,
         bty = "n")
}


```

```{r}

pdf(file = "./figures/task2_partB_setting2_acf.pdf")

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

plot_two_acfs(
  mu_1_vector, mu_1_vector_2,
  expression(paste("ACF: ", mu[1]))
)

plot_two_acfs(
  mu_2_vector, mu_2_vector_2,
  expression(paste("ACF: ", mu[2]))
)

plot_two_acfs(
  pi_vector, pi_vector_2,
  expression(paste("ACF: ", pi))
)

plot_two_acfs(
  sigma2_vector, sigma2_vector_2,
  expression(paste("ACF: ", sigma^2))
)

dev.off()

```

## Application to the faithful dataset

```{r}

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 2,
  beta_0 = 1
)

initialisation1 <- list(
      mu_1    = -1,
      mu_2    = 1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )

initialisation2 <- list(
      mu_1    = 3,
      mu_2    = 5,
      pi      = 0.8,
      sigma2  = 2
    )

initialisation3 <- list(
      mu_1    = -5,
      mu_2    = 5,
      pi      = 0.4,
      sigma2  = 2.5
    )

print(length(faithful$eruptions))
mean <- mean(faithful$eruptions)
std <- sd(faithful$eruptions)
preprocessed_data <- (faithful$eruptions - mean)/ std



```

```{r}

pdf(file="./figures/task2_faithful_data_histogram_a.pdf")

hist(faithful$eruptions, breaks = 30, xlab = "Eruption time in minutes", main ="")
dev.off()

```


```{r}

source("sampler.R")
set.seed(1)

faithful_gibbs1 <- gibbs_sampler(preprocessed_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation = initialisation1, allow_switching=FALSE)
faithful_gibbs2 <- gibbs_sampler(preprocessed_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation = initialisation2, allow_switching=FALSE)
faithful_gibbs3 <- gibbs_sampler(preprocessed_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation = initialisation3, allow_switching=FALSE)

mu_1_vector1 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs1, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector1 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs1, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector1 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs1, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector1 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs1, function (x) x$sigma2)

mu_1_vector2 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs2, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector2 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs2, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector2 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs2, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector2 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs2, function (x) x$sigma2)

mu_1_vector3 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs3, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector3 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs3, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector3 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs3, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector3 <- sapply(faithful_gibbs3, function (x) x$sigma2)


```


```{r}
pdf(file="./figures/task2_faithful_trace.pdf")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

plot(mu_1_vector1, 
     type = "l", 
     ylab = expression(mu[1]), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1])), col="blue")

lines(mu_1_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")
lines(mu_1_vector3, type = "l", col="red")

plot(mu_2_vector1, 
     type = "l", 
     ylab = expression(mu[2]),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[2])) , col="blue")

lines(mu_2_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")
lines(mu_2_vector3, type = "l", col="red")

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Initial 1", "Initial 2", "Initial 3"),
       col = c("blue", "orange", "red"),
       lty = 1,
       cex = 0.8)

plot(pi_vector1, 
     type = "l", 
     ylab = expression(pi),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi)), col="blue")

lines(pi_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")
lines(pi_vector3, type = "l", col="red")

plot(sigma2_vector1, 
     type = "l", 
     ylab = expression(sigma^2),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", sigma^2)), col="blue")

lines(sigma2_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")
lines(sigma2_vector3, type = "l", col="red")

dev.off()

```
```{r}
pdf(file="./figures/task2_faithful_acf.pdf")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

acf(mu_1_vector1, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[1])))
acf(mu_2_vector1, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[2])))
acf(pi_vector1, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", pi)))
acf(sigma2_vector1, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", sigma^2)))

dev.off()
```

### Postrior comparison

```{r}

par(mfrow=c(2,2))
hist(mu_1_vector1)
hist(mu_2_vector1)
hist(pi_vector1)
hist(sigma2_vector1)

```


```{r}

faithful_mu_1 <- mean(mu_1_vector1)
faithful_mu_2 <- mean(mu_2_vector1)
faithful_pi <- mean(pi_vector1)
faithful_sigma2 <- mean(sigma2_vector1)

print(faithful_mu_1)
print(faithful_mu_2)
print(faithful_pi)
print(faithful_sigma2)

```


```{r}

pdf(file="./figures/task2_faithful_data_histogram_b.pdf")

hist(preprocessed_data, probability = TRUE, breaks = 30, xlab = "Standardized eruption time", main = "")

curve(
  faithful_pi * dnorm(x, mean = faithful_mu_1, sd = sqrt(faithful_sigma2)) +
    (1 - faithful_pi) * dnorm(x, mean = faithful_mu_2, sd = sqrt(faithful_sigma2)),
  add = TRUE,
  col = "red",
  lwd = 2
)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Probability density function of the fitted mixture distribution"),
       col = c("red"),
       lty = 1,
       cex = 0.8)

dev.off()
```

#MCSE for fit of faithful
```{r}
ESS <- 2000 / (1+2*sum(acf(pi_vector1, plot=FALSE)$acf))
MCSE <- sd(pi_vector1)/sqrt(ESS)
MCSE
```

### Without restriction test

```{r}

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 2,
  beta_0 = 1
)

initialisation1 <- list(
      mu_1    = -1,
      mu_2    = 1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )

source("sampler.R")
set.seed(1)

faithful_gibbs <- gibbs_sampler(preprocessed_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation = initialisation1)
mu_1_vector <- sapply(faithful_gibbs, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector <- sapply(faithful_gibbs, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector <- sapply(faithful_gibbs, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector <- sapply(faithful_gibbs, function (x) x$sigma2)

```

```{r}

#pdf(file="./figures/task2_faithful_without_restriction_trace.pdf")

par(mfrow=c(1,3))

plot(mu_1_vector, 
     type = "l",
     ylab = expression(mu[1]), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1], " and ", mu[2], " without restriction")),
     col = "blue",
     ylim = c(-2,2))

lines(mu_2_vector, type = "l", col="orange")

legend("topright",
       legend = c(expression(mu[1]), expression(mu[2])),
       col = c("blue", "orange"),
       lty = 1,
       cex = 0.8)


plot(pi_vector,
     type="l", 
     ylab = expression(pi), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi, " without restriction")), 
     ylim=c(0, 1) )


plot(sigma2_vector,
     type="l", 
     ylab = expression(sigma^2), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", sigma^2, " without restriction")))

#dev.off()

```
